sections.title: Payments Technology Document Automation
sections.description: For NCR Voyix (Atlanta HQ), Global Payments (Atlanta HQ), and Transaction Alley's merchant services community.

blocks.heading: Merchant onboarding document processing
paragraphs: AI extracting structured data from merchant application packages for NCR's and Global Payments' large merchant acquisition operations — business entity verification, bank account documentation, beneficial ownership forms, and PCI compliance questionnaires that new merchant onboarding requires. Atlanta's payment processors onboard thousands of new merchants monthly — AI automation reduces per-merchant onboarding cost by eliminating manual data entry from complex application packages.

blocks.heading: Chargeback dispute document automation
paragraphs: AI processing incoming chargeback dispute packages for the payment processors' large dispute resolution operations — categorizing dispute reason codes, extracting transaction evidence, and matching to merchant records for the dispute response workflow.

blocks.heading: PCI compliance document management
paragraphs: Automated processing and tracking of PCI self-assessment questionnaires from the merchant portfolios of Atlanta's large payment processors.

sections.title: Healthcare Revenue Cycle Automation
sections.description: For Emory Healthcare, Piedmont Healthcare, Wellstar Health, and Atlanta's large health systems.

blocks.heading: Multi-payer prior authorization processing
paragraphs: AI assembling and submitting prior authorization requests for Atlanta's major commercial payers (BCBS of Georgia, UnitedHealth GA, Aetna GA, Cigna GA) and Georgia Medicaid — building clinical documentation packages, submitting to payer portals, and tracking authorization status for the enormous PA volumes generated by Atlanta's large health systems.

blocks.heading: Clinical documentation for coding
paragraphs: AI extracting structured diagnosis and procedure information from clinical notes for hospital coding teams — identifying coding opportunities and documentation deficiencies before claims are submitted.

blocks.heading: Atlanta Medicare Advantage appeals
paragraphs: Automated appeal letter generation for denied Medicare Advantage claims — a significant and growing automation opportunity as MA's prior auth and claims denial rates create large appeal volumes for Atlanta health systems.

sections.title: Logistics and Transportation Document Automation
sections.description: For UPS (Atlanta suburb HQ, adjacent Atlanta), Delta Air Lines (Atlanta HQ), and the logistics community.

blocks.heading: Air cargo documentation processing
paragraphs: AI processing air waybills, dangerous goods declarations, and customs documentation for the large air cargo flows through Hartsfield-Jackson — reducing manual data entry for the cargo handling agents and freight forwarders processing the world's busiest airport's air freight.

blocks.heading: Driver qualification file automation
paragraphs: AI processing commercial driver qualification files for the large trucking companies and fleet operators in Atlanta's logistics community — extracting MVR data, medical certificate information, and training records from driver files.

blocks.heading: Delta flight operations document automation
paragraphs: Internal document processing automation for Delta's large flight operations and regulatory compliance documentation burden.

sections.title: Legal Operations Automation
sections.description: For Alston & Bird, King & Spalding, and Atlanta's BigLaw community.

blocks.heading: Contract review automation
paragraphs: AI extracting key terms, obligations, and risk provisions from commercial contracts for Atlanta's large corporate law practices — reducing the manual contract review burden for M&A due diligence, vendor contract review, and lease portfolio management.

blocks.heading: Real estate transaction document processing
paragraphs: AI for Atlanta's active commercial real estate transaction market — processing closing documents, title commitments, and survey reports for the lawyers and title companies serving Atlanta's large CRE transaction market.

blocks.heading: Georgia court filing automation
paragraphs: AI for organizing and processing Georgia state and federal court filings, discovery documents, and regulatory submissions for Atlanta's litigation community.

sections.title: Atlanta automation technical context
sections.description: Key technical and compliance considerations for Atlanta automation deployments.

blocks.heading: PCI DSS scope management
paragraphs: Payment document automation for Atlanta's large payment processor community must strictly limit PCI DSS scope — full cardholder data (PANs, CVVs) must never enter the AI automation pipeline. ClickMasters designs payments automation with PCI DSS scope exclusion as a primary architecture constraint.

blocks.heading: Georgia Medicaid and Centurion compliance
paragraphs: Healthcare automation for Atlanta's health systems must align with Georgia's Medicaid program (DCH) requirements and the Alliant Health Plans managed care contract requirements.
